description: For drywall repair, this estimate request form records cutout boundary, backing, board type, treatment, drying intervals, dust control, texture match, and painting handoff. use_case: Use the estimate request form during drywall damage repair and finish restoration when the drywall repair record must identify room, surface, substrate, damage dimensions, texture, finish, utilities, moisture source, and occupancy constraints. Complete the applicable handoff for dryness and finish verification, cleaned area, paint responsibility, customer acceptance, and recurrence note.
